provenance_legend.composition_amounts: Active-ingredient amounts are CITED to the product label. EXCIPIENT AMOUNTS ARE NOT_FOUND FOR EVERY PRODUCT: quantities of inactive ingredients are trade secret and appear in neither the label prose nor the structured SPL. B2 verified this across all 10 SPLs parsed — the <quantity> element is populated only for ACTIB/ACTIM active ingredients. Use the FDA IID max_amount_per_day_mg ceiling in each excipient record instead.

scope_note: The brief asked for '5 modeled pill products'. B2 delivered EIGHT, and the extra three are deliberate. Five are the one-per-locked-drug monotherapy products (lisinopril, losartan, amlodipine, hydrochlorothiazide, metoprolol succinate ER). The sixth is metoprolol tartrate IR, included because the product's 'best formulation type' claim needs two real, base-matched, label-comparable formulations of one moiety side by side, and metoprolol is the ONLY drug in the set where that comparison exists at label level. The seventh and eighth are the two real fixed-dose combinations the shared context mandates (Zestoretic and Hyzaar) — these are what make 'a pill is a composition of substances' a fact about the world rather than a UI metaphor. If the team must have exactly five cards on the Pills page, drop nothing: show all eight and let the FDCs carry the pitch.

value: heart failure (NYHA II-III, stable, ischaemic/hypertensive/cardiomyopathic origin)

provenance.source: FDA/DailyMed SPL, TOPROL-XL (metoprolol succinate) ER tablets, Melinta, setid 496ddfaa-7c9c-4888-b747-a210249b367a
provenance.quote: TOPROL-XL is indicated for the treatment of hypertension ... to reduce cardiovascular mortality and hospitalization in patients with heart failure
provenance.note: HEART FAILURE IS AN INDICATION FOR THIS PRODUCT AND NOT FOR THE IMMEDIATE-RELEASE TARTRATE. This is a SALT- AND FORMULATION-SPECIFIC indication, not a metoprolol-moiety indication: the mortality evidence (MERIT-HF) was generated with metoprolol succinate ER, and the FDA approved the indication for that product only. Any engine that models metoprolol as one drug with a formulation attribute WILL recommend an unindicated product for heart failure.

products.salt_distinction_note: SALT FORM IS A FIRST-CLASS DISTINCTION IN THIS FILE, NOT A FORMULATION ATTRIBUTE. prod_metoprolol_succinate_er_tablet and prod_metoprolol_tartrate_tablet are SEPARATE product records with different salts, different release profiles, different excipient sets (only titanium dioxide is shared), different dosing intervals (24 h vs 12 h) and DIFFERENT APPROVED INDICATIONS. They share one substance record (`metoprolol`, the moiety) because the pharmacodynamics are label-stated to be formulation-independent — but they must never be collapsed into one product.
products.notes: THE ONLY METOPROLOL PRODUCT WITH A HEART FAILURE INDICATION. If the twin has heart failure, this product is correct and prod_metoprolol_tartrate_tablet is not — a genuine, sourced, formulation-level recommendation.

excipient_provenance.note: THREE STRENGTHS OF ONE BRAND, THREE DIFFERENT EXCIPIENT SETS. 100/12.5 has no dye; 50/12.5 and 100/25 do. If a dye-sensitive patient needs this combination, the SIMULATOR CAN NAME THE SPECIFIC STRENGTH THAT IS SAFE. That is a level of specificity a molecule-level tool structurally cannot reach, and it is the clearest possible demonstration of why the Pills page exists.

provenance.note: ESTIMATED. The Hyzaar label does not carry an explicit bioequivalence sentence in the text B2 retrieved, unlike Zestoretic. Superposition is nonetheless the standard regulatory assumption for an approved FDC and B2 recommends it — but the CITED bioequivalence statement is Zestoretic's, not Hyzaar's. Do not misattribute it.

ESTIMATED SYNTHESIS, and the most interesting pharmacology in the product set. Hydrochlorothiazide RAISES serum urate (Tier 2: +48 umol/L at 25 mg, and only 12.3 mg is needed for +36 umol/L). Losartan is uricosuric and LOWERS it — a class-unique property of losartan among ARBs, mediated by URAT1 inhibition. The combination is therefore PARTLY SELF-CORRECTING FOR URATE, which is precisely why losartan/HCTZ is the preferred thiazide combination in a patient with gout or hyperuricaemia, and why lisinopril/HCTZ is not equivalent. B2 could not source a quantitative net-urate figure for the fixed combination within the timebox — the DIRECTION is well established, the MAGNITUDE is NOT SOURCED. Flag it in the UI as directional. AGENT C: this should be a positive/compelling-indication rule, not just the absence of a contraindication.

ESTIMATED by analogy to the Tier-1 lisinopril/HCTZ statement. ARBs and ACE inhibitors both reduce aldosterone, so the mechanism is the same, but B2 found no equivalent explicit sentence in the Hyzaar label. Directionally safe, magnitude not label-confirmed for this product.
ESTIMATED additive, by analogy to the Tier-1 lisinopril/HCTZ statement. ARB + thiazide is conventionally treated as additive.

products.notes: THE SECOND REAL FIXED-DOSE COMBINATION, and pharmacologically the more interesting of the two: it is the answer to the gout reject case. Where HCTZ alone must be refused in a gout patient, HCTZ combined with losartan is the standard workaround.
